body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Sonos introduced 'Sonos Family' including 'ZonePlayer S5' at The Digital Experience, America's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which was held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.

The 'ZonePlayer S5' is a high-performance, all-in-one wireless music system that delivers crystal-clear, room-filling sound. Simply plug it in wherever you want music and enjoy. The 5-driver speaker system is individually powered by 5 dedicated digital amplifiers and includes 2 tweeters, 2 mid-range drivers and 1 subwoofer for high-quality sound that rivals much larger, more complicated audio equipment. To start playing music, one ZonePlayer or ZoneBridge must be connected to the router, then all the rest work wirelessly. The S5 is available in both black and white.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
